column1: # The calibration contract for autospec's UI gates, measured against scripts/lint-ui.sh
#   correct   the rule fires where it should, or stays quiet where it should
#   over-fire the rule fires on code that is not a defect  (false positive)
#   missed    the rule stays quiet on code that is a defect (false negative)
# A rule id of "-" means no finding is expected for that file. Re-run
# scripts/lint-ui.sh over these paths and diff against this table: a row that changes
# verdict is either a regression or a fix, and either way wants a look.

column4: compliant reference: zoomable viewport, labelled controls, skip link
oklch colour, 4px spacing scale, non-generic type stack
movement with its reduced-motion fallback in the same file
hex directly after the colon is caught
one finding per line, both directives on one line
a guard with no motion of its own draws nothing
guard lives in global-reset.css; the rule is per-file
matched the directive name inside prose, not the meta tag
